entities.name: Hugh W. Cross

entities.summary: Hugh Ware Cross was an American politician, lawyer, farmer, and businessman who served as chairman of the Interstate Commerce Commission, lieutenant governor of Illinois, and speaker of the Illinois House of Representatives.
